title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
description: After a life-changing incident, timid college student Koichi Haimawari accepts an offer from revered vigilante Knuckleduster to train as his protégé.

episodes.title: S1-E13What a Man Takes with Him
S2-E8A Sky with No Rain Left

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Koichi is convinced he'll never manage to become a hero, until he meets someone with an odd take on justice.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Some people frown upon vigilante activities, but the least they could do is remember The Crawler's name.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The drug Trigger is wreaking havoc all over town, but figuring out who's dealing it is easier said than done.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: What happens when pro heroes and vigilantes target the same villain? Is it possible to work as a team?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Koichi and Pop each find themselves considerably influenced by various events from their pasts.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Hachisuka tries manipulating Stendhal into fighting targets of her choosing, but can anyone control him?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Makoto offers to help a struggling Koichi with his studies, but she requests something surprising in return.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The American hero Captain Celebrity sets up shop in Japan, and it isn't long before trouble begins.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Koichi's mother is in town, and he's willing to take drastic measures so that she'll let him stay in Tokyo.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Pop receives a request to perform at an upcoming local event, and she finds herself in need of guidance.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Preparing for Narufest proves to be an uphill battle. Will teamwork be what gets everyone to the finish line?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: There's trouble when the power goes out at Narufest, all while Knuckleduster fights a very personal battle.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Narufest turned out to be a huge success, but our vigilantes must decide whether it's time for some changes.
